mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Company (company_Code, company_Name, company_Type, company_Email, ceo_Name, tel_No) VALUES ( #{companyCode}, #{companyName}, #{companyType, typeHandler=com.itwillbs.ilkwangtech.sales.constant.CommonEnumTypeHandler}, #{companyEmail}, #{ceoName}, #{telNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT company_Id, company_Code, company_Name, company_Type, company_Email, ceo_Name, tel_No FROM Company WHERE company_Name = #{companyName}

SELECT company_Id, company_Code, company_Name, company_Type, company_Email, ceo_Name, tel_No FROM Company WHERE company_Type = #{companyType, typeHandler=com.itwillbs.ilkwangtech.sales.constant.CommonEnumTypeHandler} or company_Type = 3 ORDER BY company_id ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
